summary: First full run of AMTS Phase 1. Backend: existing 29-test suite passed (isolated DB); new external-URL suite (16 tests) passed; live simulated-agent suite (2 tests: export schema validation, invalid transitions STARTING->PAUSED 409, double start 409 SESSION_ALREADY_ACTIVE, delete active 409, resume while RECORDING 409, COMPLETED pause/resume/stop 409, delete -> 404) passed. Frontend: no-agent state (amber header, banner, start disabled, 0 devices), Sessions DEMO creation + DEMO labels, Recorded Steps (inspect drawer 4 tabs with content, rename/description/verification/locator switch saved, remove w/ confirm, raw log keeps 6 events incl. masked PIN, reorder warning dialog only first time, export download), TR/EN toggle, dark/light toggle persisted, Settings (token shown once with agent.properties snippet, interval save + persistence, validation error <500, audit log entries), planned badge TR/EN. LIVE simulated recorder: header green, SIMULATED Pixel FAKE-0001 Companion Etkin, select, Start -> BAŞLATILIYOR -> KAYDEDİLİYOR, feed SCREEN_CHANGE/TAP(HYBRID Transfer)/INPUT_TEXT [MASKELİ · 4]/BACK, latest screenshot rendered (1080px, REDACTED), Pause freezes duration, Resume, Stop -> TAMAMLANDI, Save, Export, Clear (confirm) -> BOŞTA; disconnect -> BAŞARISIZ within ~1s with 'Android device disconnected during recording.'; pkill agent -> header amber in ~11s, start disabled. All flows working. Cleanup done: agent killed, all DEMO/SIMULATED sessions deleted (0 remain), token rotated, capture interval restored to 3000.

minor.issue: Non-existent session_id with empty order returns 200 ok (sorted([])==sorted([])); should 404 via ss.get_session.
Do not verify session exists; return [] instead of 404.
Allows editing a removed step (removed:true) without error.
Stays set to FAKE-0001 after agent disconnects/device offline; never cleared (remains in DB now, SettingsUpdate likely cannot clear it).

ui_bugs.issue: After agent disconnect, header and Recorder KV still show 'Aktif Cihaz: FAKE-0001' although no agent/device is online - stale device shown as active (conflicts with 'never show devices as real when not connected').
After Clear (IDLE) recorder-duration shows 00:00:01 instead of 00:00:00 (useTicker base not reset when session becomes null).

step-row/step-inspect/step-move testids use step.order; after removing step 1 rows are step-row-2..5 while displayed index is 1..4 (testids unstable). Opening /recorded-steps without id shows empty 'Oturum seçin' instead of auto-selecting latest session.

issues: Audit log table headers 'Action' / 'Target' not translated in TR
Validation toast shows raw English pydantic message 'Input should be greater than or equal to 500' in TR UI
Agent properties snippet uses 'adb.path=adb' default - fine, but backend.url points to preview URL
Amber 'agent not connected' pill text on pale amber background has lowish contrast

action_items: Clear or visually mark stale active_device_serial when agent not connected / device offline (header + Recorder)
Reset recorder duration ticker to 0 when session cleared
Translate audit table headers and map backend validation errors to i18n
critical_code_review_comments: session_routes._control transitions state before queuing the agent command; if queue_command fails the state is already changed (low risk).
reorder_steps does N sequential update_one calls; consider bulk_write.
export_session writes an audit entry on every export (also on every UI download) - fine but noisy.
pytest.ini forces '-n ... --dist loadscope' (xdist); use '-n 0' for the live-agent file.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; minor stale-state UI issues)

seed_data_creation: None left. DEMO and SIMULATED sessions created during testing were deleted; token rotated afterwards. settings.active_device_serial remains 'FAKE-0001' (cannot clear via API). Agent/device docs of SIMULATED-contract-test remain in agents/devices collections (offline).
